Allows administrators to create managed developer environments in the cloud.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `WorkstationsClient`: Service for interacting with Cloud Workstations.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `WorkstationsClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudWorkstationsV1
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, workstationClusterId: String, workstationConfigId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudWorkstationsV1.WorkstationsClient()
  let items = client.listWorkstationsByItems(
    request: ListWorkstationsRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)/workstationClusters/\(workstationClusterId)/workstationConfigs/\(workstationConfigId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Requirements

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-workstations-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-workstations-v1.git --from 0.5.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudWorkstationsV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudWorkstationsV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-workstations-v1
```
